notes.title: New World Update 3.0.3
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6vLzi8qkd5wYNhfFBMb5e3/ab46bc35d2041f50d89e0cffaa11ce34/NW_TukeryTerrorWeaponSkin_D_1920x1080_Final_CT-002782.jpg
Greetings, Adventurers!

New World Update 3.0.3 downtime will begin at 11:00PM PT (6:00AM UTC) on November 14 and last approximately 1 hour. Aeternum has survived the hauntings of Nightveil Hallow, but a familiar foe is back for revenge—Turkulon. Check out the full release notes, including new Knightsbane Legion skins and Black Friday bundles, bug fixes, and more.

KNIGHTSBANE LEGION AND BLACK FRIDAY BUNDLES
[previewyoutube=LQNeNdNNfn8;full][/previewyoutube]
The Dark Legion invades the Store this month! Special skins for those who have abandoned the code of chivalry are now available. Smile as your opponents’ blood runs cold at the sight of you. Whatever your style, visit the Store for special promo bundles featuring unvaulted content and brand new skins, including the Gladekeeper Bundle, the Azoth Arcana Bundle, and the Maulers and Brawlers Bundle. Select housing items and tool skins are 50% off for a limited time.

FIGHT TURKULON FOR THE GRAND GOBBLER
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/M4IVjHNgZuhzt2CVQB6kt/67bb5596a898e6dc5c393a92eddb2f65/NW_TukeryTerrorWeaponSkin_A_1920x1080_Final_CT-002782.jpg
Satisfy your hunger for carnage with the succulent Grand Gobbler War Hammer when Turkulon returns on November 15 through 28. Hunt down the Feathered Avenger of Death and his ‘fowl army’ to earn unique, event-specific items. Thanks to player feedback from last year, loot will now drop more frequently. There are also even more desirable rewards, like a giant turkey leg, waiting to be served.

RELEASE NOTES
WORLD EXPERIENCE

 Added a tag to the named AI to ignore the spawn scaling effect, lowering the spawn rate at the Dayspring Tree POI.
 Adjusted spawns for the Staff of Wizardry encounter to prevent stalls when new enemies appear.

EXPEDITIONS

 Fixed an issue that caused gatherables to not appear in Starstone Barrows.

GLOBAL MUTATORS

 Fixed an issue with the enemy count in Dynasty Shipyard. It is now 60.
 Fixed an issue with Guldar not counting towards the Named Enemy Count in The Depths.

COMBAT CHANGES
Artifacts

 Scorpion's Sting - Added trade off to Sting Perk - Increases cooldown by 50% upon use.
 Lost Stopwatch - Changed duration from a 100% increase to a flat 1s increase.
 Increased damage reduction trade off from 5% to 10%.
 Odo - Updated functionality to include that the damage bonus applies to knocked down targets.

Disease Status Effects:

 All Player Diseases - Added an outgoing healing penalty to all disease status effects equal to half of the incoming healing reduction. (Plagued Crits, Plagued Strikes, Plagued Splitting Grenade, Infected Throw, Putrefying Scream, PvP Arenas Healing Reduction)
 Plagued Crits - Removed health requirement. It can now be refreshed while active.
 Plagued Strikes - It can now be refreshed while active.

Perks

 Shirking Heals - Increased cooldown from 5s to 10s
 Slash/Physical Ward/Absorptions - Updated all physical ward and slash ward Gems and Perks to include bleed damage as a part of slash damage to function similarly to other dots.
 Exhaustive Net Shot - Reduced duration from 8s to 4s.

Blunderbuss

 Increased base damage by 3.75% in PvE and reduced base damage in PvP by an additional 3.62% to keep PvP Damage the same.
 Last Chance Passive - Reduced from 50% to 30% Fortify
 On A Roll Passive - Made it so each stack has its own unique duration
 Primary Fire - Reduced damage coefficient from 23% per pellet to 21% per pellet
 ASB - Reduced damage from 50% per pellet to 45% per pellet.

Life Staff

 Splash Of Light - Reduced Radius from 100m to 25m

Void Gauntlet

 Void Blade - Removed duration limit of Void blade, now remains active until weapon becomes inactive.
 Fixed an issue that caused several staggering attacks to not trigger the increment for the breakout dodge.
 Fixed an issue with attacks that didn’t stagger but unintentionally incremented the breakout dodge.

PVP REWARD TRACK NAMED ITEMS

 Fixed an issue that prevented certain named PvP item upgrades.
 To address, we’ve added new versions of the PvP Reward Track Named Items with a 5th generated Perk. Unlike the originals, these new Named Items can be upgraded at a Gypsum Kiln. To make it easier for Adventurers to distinguish the two, the old PvP Reward Track Named Items no longer have the 'Named' tag.

ECONOMY, PROGRESSION, & GEAR

 Disabled the ability to use Secrets of the Spores potions in Arena PvP.
 Disabled Artemis Boon status effects when joining Arena PvP instances and non-Savage Divide Expeditions.
 Updated the description for the Azoth Inductor for further clarity.
 Chromatic Ward: Fixed an issue that prevented this Perk from working properly.
 Fixed an issue where if you crafted multiple items, and one became a named item, you would not receive the other items.
 Fixed an issue that caused Beast Hoards to drop loot at a lower than intended Gear Score.
 Adjusted the Aptitude crates the player can purchase in the Faction shop at Rank 6.
 These chests no longer award 2-3 rare Tier 5 materials. They will now offer 60-120 Tier 52 raw materials instead.
 Fixed an issue that caused Mythril Rings and Earrings to not function as intended.

GAME MODES

 Fixed a rare issue that caused War instances to not start properly.
 Simultaneous Influence Races will be enabled on Abaton as part of a test.

UX/UI/SOCIAL

 Fixed an issue that caused bundles with items locked to Rise of the Angry Earth to overlap text on top of the bundle cost when viewed in the Store by players that do not own the expansion.
 Fixed a rare issue that crashed the game when viewing results for Influence Races that included more than 20 Companies.
 The auto-pin toggle for Town Project Missions and Artifact objectives now works properly.
 Fixed an issue that caused certain Dye to be unusable.
 Fixed Dye issues for the following skins:
 Black Spire
 Penitent Assassin
 Somber Legionnaire
 Fixed visual issues with skirts, cloths, and other skin colliders.

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World Update 3.0.2
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/70yzDV4gR2kLdpssSLJ6Ig/1d1cb52565d5c2499562cc1ee02127d7/NW_NightveilHallow_Screenshots_Costumes_Final_1920x1080_CT-002723.jpg
Greetings, Adventurers!

New World Update 3.0.2 downtime will begin at 11:00PM PT (6:00AM UTC) on October 31 and last approximately 1 hour. Check out the most recent release notes, including bug fixes and the Nightveil Hallow community costume contest winners.

RELEASE NOTES
ALT CHARACTERS

 Players will no longer be restricted to one character per world that can PvP at a time – all their characters will be able to PvP! Our changes to Influence and other protections like Shell Company Mitigation largely reduce the impact of Alt Characters on Territory Control. If exploits appear we will bring back the restriction, but otherwise intend to keep it off indefinitely.

WORLD EXPERIENCE
This section was updated on 10/31:

 Temporarily disabled loot drops from Yetis in Edengrove and Shattered Mountain.
 Fixed an issue that caused the same Mutations to cycle together.
 Fixed an exploit for the Montrapala bosses in the Elysian Wilds.
 Fixed an issue with the Faction Mission "Cauterizing a Wound" by adding mission items to gorillas in the POI area.
 Fixed an issue that prevented progress when talking to Granny, Zander's employer.
 Shortened the following mount races: Four Seasons Tour, Barrens and Bogs Tour, Island Tour, and Sands and Storms Tour.
 The Trading Post achievement is now unlocked at the start of Inn quest.
 Fixed an issue in Starstone Barrows with the Normal Enemy Count.
 Improved bandwidth allocation for characters in large groups.
 Fixed an issue that caused mount audio to persist after dismount.

ARTIFACTS

 Updated the Lost Stopwatch Artifact to provide additional threat generation similar to normal taunt gems.
 Fixed an issue that prevented players from getting an Artifact to drop again after not picking it up following a disconnect.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Well Rounded perk on the Attuned Leather Pants Artifact to not provide 10 to all stats and incorrectly display on the tooltip with the Magnify perk.

HEARTRUNES
Increased damage of the following:

 Dark Ascent Heartrune by 20%
 Fire Storm Heartrune by 33%
 Devourer Heartrune by 26%

WEAPONS
Blunderbuss

 Reduced base damage value in PvP from -9% to -12%

Ice Gauntlet

 Fixed an issue that caused the player to get stuck in the tomb pose if Ice Tomb was destroyed while spawning.

Rapier

 Fixed an issue that caused the Flurry Fleeting Strikes upgrade to not function properly.
 Fixed an issue that caused the tooltip to not show the updated value of 5% from a previous balance change.

PERKS

 Physical/Elemental Aversion - Increased max power from 4.2% to 4.5%.
 Damage Type Conditioning - Increased power from 4% to 5%
 Slowing Tether - Adjusted disintegrate bonus to only apply a single stack of disintegrate on use.
 Healthy Toast - Changed from 11% of max health to 15% of base health.
 Added a 1s cooldown to the Tumbler Footwraps Shirking Blessing Perk.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Shirking Heals health percentage heal to scale with Gear Score.
 Now caps at 1.5% of max health at 700 GS and will properly show the scaled value in the tool-tip.

NIGHTVEIL HALLOW

 Fixed an issue that prevented players from targeting Baalphazu if too many players were in the area.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Nightveil Hallow Hatchet patterns to not appear in the crafting menu.

ECONOMY, PROGRESSION, & GEAR

 Fixed an issue that prevented the Ethereal Orichalcum Round Shield and Voidbent Orichalcum Round Shield from appearing in the Stylemancer menu.
 Fixed an issue that prevented Elysian Wild housing items from being salvageable.
 Fixed an issue that caused certain items to roll with Perks that should have been unavailable at their Gear Score.
 Rank 6 Faction Round Shields have had their Refreshing Ward perk swapped to Keenly Empowered.
 Some Mutator accessories cannot be updated and will instead drop as fixed versions. The previous perks, like Focused or Refreshing Ward, will now drop as valid Perks at that Gear Score.
 Fixed an issue that caused outdated gear and Perks to drop for players.
 Fixed an issue that prevented influence rewards from dropping Flails.

APTITUDE

 Expansion Crafting Aptitude Chests now have the ability to drop Timeless Shards.
 Fixed an issue that caused Alchemy Aptitude Crates to roll a lower tier of Death Essence and prevented Death Quintessence rolls.
 Woodworking and Logging Aptitude chests for the expansion now have raw materials instead of refined materials.
 Weaving expansion Aptitude Chests now contain T52 fibers as intended.

CRAFTING

 Fixed an issue that caused Named Item re-roll recipes to not be visible for Savage Divide Named Items.
 Fixed an issue that caused the incorrect recipe name to display for a few Named Item re-roll recipes.
 Fixed an issue that caused Empyrean Forge Dense Materia recipes to only appear if Ennead Dense Materia was in the player's inventory.
 Reduced crafting coin cost on the materia conversion recipes to the minimum possible value.
 Fixed an issue where some upgraded crafting recipes failed, but still changed your item.

SEASONS

 Clarified phrasing in the descriptions of the 'Fellowship of the Flail' Journey Tasks.
 Fixed an issue where killing Shirzad's Cave Lions contributed towards the "Kill Ancient Guardians" Season Activity.
 Fixed a typo in:
 "Faction Family" Journey task
 Writhing Seedlings for the Savage Divide Expedition and Mutation boxes.
 It now properly shows Crystalline Fur as a drop.
 Removed "Complete a Mount Race" Season Activity. It becomes impossible once players complete every mount race.
 Fixed an issue that slowed progression for the “Mushroom Muncher” Journey Task when consuming Spore Jelly potions too quickly.
 Fixed an issue where players with completed but unstamped Season Activities were rewarded more Season XP than intended when their card was re-rolled.

MARKS OF FORTUNE

 In response to fluctuations in currency exchange rates around the world, we updated our localized price points for in-game purchases outside of the United States to align with our retail product prices on Steam.

COMMUNITY COSTUME CONTEST
We asked you to share your best Nightveil Hallow Costumes for a chance to win 2 Transmog Tokens. Congratulations to the following winners:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6JgGgN25aC6dGMXdd0uX8b/df51ad130213bf4e5f08e88664c28b7f/NW_Nightveil_Hallow_Contest_1920x1080_CT-002869.jpg
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World Update 3.0.1
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1Pv2KoQD8iobaf3rpUx6Yy/c6da23d5e5868064f5bfdc6b61deb1f9/NW_NightveilHallow_Screenshots_CostumesCauldron_Final_1920x1080_CT-002723.jpg

Greetings, Adventurers!

New World Update 3.0.1 downtime will begin at 11:00PM PT (6:00AM UTC) on October 17 and last approximately 1 hour. Transform into some of your favorite characters like Captain Thorpe to celebrate the spooky season in Nightveil Hallow. This update also includes the Umbral Rites store release, a community mount showcase, and more. Check out the full release below.

NIGHTVEIL HALLOW
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/tE1wzUA5MJCXOfGqbz8MA/5d587b5795b6ead0fa04ac1cb271b082/EN-US_NW_NightveilHallow_KeyArt_Web_Main_1920x1080_300kb_Final_CT-002146.jpg
Nightveil Hallow returns as Baalphazu, Marquis of Terror rises once again on October 18 until November 14. Banish the shadowy demon back to the darkness, don unique costumes, and trick-or-treat for new candy rewards. You can also purchase new and returning event-specific items in the Event Shop.

UMBRAL RITE STORE RELEASE
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6ZN8CjqXQjtNKI6itjBfyk/a77411d1d9caec5a5756e9ce41be7f38/October-Store-Update-Image_CFF.jpg
Spirits from beyond the grave roam more freely on Aeternum than the world at large. Best they don't know you too intimately. Check out skins like the Séance Mask Bundle, the Fatebound Ossuary Weapon Bundle, Midnight Portents Armor Bundle, and the Ritual Hut, plus a T-rex walk emote and more. Which will you add to your collection?

RELEASE NOTES
October 18 Update: The Development Team made additional changes late in our release cycle and missed the original patch note deadline, but these changes were included in the latest patch.
GENERAL

 Improved engine performance for world asset streaming, allowing objects to load in faster with less visual hitches.
 Improved client stability by fixing a number of client crashes that were introduced with the recent expansion release.
 Improved server stability by fixing a number of server crashes that were introduced with the recent expansion.
 Fixed an issue that caused AI to have a very small rendering distance, giving the appearance that they were only spawning "right on top" of the player.
 Fixed a rare issue that caused the error 'Character_Restore_Failure' upon character login to a world.

WORLD EXPERIENCE

 Fixed an issue that allowed players to go out of bounds during the Medusa soul trial in Elysian Wilds.
 Fixed an audio issue with Medusa’s VO.
 Fixed an issue that allowed Ifrit in Empyrean Forge to perform other attacks during Flamethrower.
 Updated entry requirements for trial during 'Beyond the Gates' quest
 The Tier 4 Azoth Staff will now be received through the new main story quests in Edengrove, as well as still recognized by the old main story quests.
 Adjusted encounter in the Staff of Wizardry quest to ensure players are consistently able to retrigger the encounter for proper progression.
 Fixed an issue that prevented progress for multiple players in the ‘Plague for all Factions’ quest.
 Fixed an issue that prevented progress in the ‘A Friend in Need’ Quest.
 Fixed an issue that prevented simultaneous progress in the quests ‘Tracking the Herd’ and ‘Abducted Artificer’.
 Fixed an issue that didn’t alert players to a timed encounter in the quest ‘Factions Untied’.
 Fixed an issue that prevented NPCs from appearing in the quest ‘The Best of Aeternum’.
 Fixed an issue with VOs in the Beast Lords and New Eden cinematics.
 Fixed an issue that prevented progress in the ‘Purge: Brysedd Shore’ Faction mission.
 Fixed an issue that displayed the incorrect Landmark difficulty inside ‘Dance of the Fireflies’.
 Fixing an issue that prevented Joven from exiting his cage in Dynasty Shipyard.
 Fixed an issue that prevented players from teleporting or summoning their mount at Shrines.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Razor Azalea to spawn under a rock.
 Fixed an issue that prevented progression in the ‘First Light, Last Stand’ quest.
 Fixed an issue that prevented players from progressing 'Dance of the Fireflies'.
 Blocked off an unintended route to the Tribunal Highmound POI.
 Added missing water to pool in the Saircor Orrey.
 Added a wall in Nyharts Anchorage to prevent players from becoming stuck in the structure.
 The Patriarchs in Kurok's Anchorage will now respawn faster when more players are in the vicinity in order to ease bottlenecking.
 Reduced the number of local AI during the 'The Invasion of Artemis' quest in order to lower the difficulty.
 Fixed an issue that prevented the Elite Overlord Moonflower Floe from spawning.
 Added camp placement prevention to all quest interactable locations, reducing the opportunity for griefing behavior from other players.
 Fixed an issue that prevented the 'To Warm The Soul Warden' from being completed. Pedro can now be found at the outpost when the player arrives.
 Fixed an issue where players could become soft-locked while the client awaits a successful response from the server for fast-traveling or summoning a mount when the nearby vicinity is overloaded with other players.

COMBAT

 Fixed an issue that caused the Sundering Javelin perk’s tooltip to not mention the cooldown reduction.
 Fixed an issue that allowed players to take damage behind Fort & Outpost gates and prevented repairs.
 Fixed an issue that caused inconsistent results when unequipping a weapon.
 Fixed an issue where 1-Handed Sword's 'Defensive Formation' ultimate was unintentionally able to be removed by the Void Gauntlet's 'Nullifying Oblivion' perk.
 Increased Influence Race win requirements and the value of Influence Watches to balance against completing missions as a form of ending a race too quickly. The Influence Watches are now worth 30 points every 5 seconds and provide a 20% bonus. Known issue: the tooltip for the Watches are not updated, however, the map flyout will show the correct numbers.

ARTIFACTS

 Fixed an issue that caused the Endless Thirst artifact to increase the cooldown of non-healing related consumables.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Magnetic Gauntlets Artifact to reduce critical damage to a lower value than non-critical damage.
 Anhk Amulet Artifact - Center of Attention Perk - Reduced both positive and negative values from 50% to 25%
 Unyielding Helm Artifact - Hard Head Perk - Added additional functionality that reduces weight to allow usage with more equipment loads.
 Fixed an issue where the Well Rounded perk on the Attuned Leather Pants artifact was not properly giving 10 to all stats and was not displaying on the tooltip correctly with the Magnify perk.
 Adjusted PvP Track obtained Artifacts to no longer require unique PvP kills and instead track general PvP kills.

FLAIL

 Fixed an issue that prevented the Fortifies applied by Flail's Barrage ability from being dispelled by effects that removes buffs.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Flail's Arcane Vortex Flailing Stability upgrade to cleanse applied status effects that should not be able to be dispelled.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Flail Barrage, Arcane Eruption, and Arcane Vortex abilities to stop or cut short if activated while blocking.
 Adjusted Barrage to not block cancel during the start up, prior to forward transition, if block is held. The block now has to be pressed to trigger the start up block cancel.
 Adjusted the timing of the block and dodge cancels to be after the second hit of Vortex instead of the first. This also lines up better with the player’s position.
 Adjusted the timing of the block cancel for Arcane Eruption to line up better with the player's body position to reduce wonky animations during the cancel.

MOUNTS

 Fixed an issue that caused sheathed weapons to make loud sounds when riding a mount.
 Fixed an issue that caused mounts to not animate correctly in various situations like being fed.
 Fixed an issue that caused the mount race timer to not show up after players exited an Expedition.
 Fixed an issue that prevented progression for players that crafted Vittles in the 'Hungry as a Horse' quest.
 Adjusted the label for Mount Attachments in the store to make it clear that they’re attachment skins and not items.
 Shortened 4 mount races based on player feedback: Four Seasons Tour, Barrens and Bogs Tour, Island Tour, and Sands and Storms Tour
 Fixed an issue with several mount attachment icons that appeared to be squished.

ECONOMY, PROGRESSION, & GEAR

 Cooking Aptitude Boxes now have a chance to roll bananas.
 Trophy mats now drop out of furnishing Aptitude Crates as intended.
 The clothing patterns for the 700 Gear Score Gathering sets now have the proper icons.
 Fixed an issue that caused the icons on the Mythril Rings and Earrings to flip.
 Fixed an issue that caused Timeless shard recipes for Mythril Rings and Mythril Earrings to require the wrong materials.
 Mythril Jewelry that use Timeless Shards or Scarabs will now have the proper attribute amounts.
 Expansion Furnishing recipes have had their ingredients updated to better fit the items being crafted.
 Fixed an issue that caused Black Gypsum to drop at a faster rate than intended.
 Added Dark Matter and Transmog Token Purses to Elysian Wilds Elite Chests.
 Added the Flail Timeless Shard as possible loot to the Aptitude Chests for Arcana.
 Wars and Invasions will now reward Dark Matter upon completion. The amount depends on your reward tier.
 Invasions can reward 50 or 75 Dark Matter.
 Wars can reward higher level players up to 100 Dark Matter.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Available Rewards screen to display incorrectly when viewing Mutators for Starstone Barrows, Dynasty Shipyard, and The Depths. This fix causes some grey items to display in the rewards section, but these items will roll perks correctly. A more comprehensive fix is coming in the future.
 Fixed an issue that caused certain AI in The Depths and Dynasty Shipyard to drop old items with Perks that players should no longer be able to obtain.
 Fixed an issue that caused certain items to roll with Perks that should have been unavailable at their Gear Score.
 Rank 6 Faction Round Shields have had their Refreshing Ward Perk swapped to Keenly Empowered.
 Some Mutator accessories cannot be updated and will instead drop as a fixed version. The previous Perks like Focused and Refreshing Ward should now drop as perks valid at that Gear Score.
 Fixed an issue that prevented a mount item from dropping in the Savage Divide.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Harbinger Life and Fire Staves to swap icons.
 Fixed an issue that caused a duplicate Health perk on the King of the Jungle Head armor.
 Fixed an issue that caused ‘Dance of the Fireflies’ rewards to roll at a lower Gear Score than intended.
 Fixed an issue that caused items to be lost when moving in-bulk to a storage that doesn't have enough capacity. 

UI/UX/SOCIAL

 The game will now immediately activate Rise of the Angry Earth upon purchase rather than on sign in.
 Fixed an issue that softlocked players when cancelling a pending purchase in the store.
 Fixed an issue that caused damage and health previews to be incorrect when spending points on the Attributes screen.
 Fixed an issue with Legendary Beast tooltip images.
 Fixed an issue with the display size and resolution for Influence Race results.
 Fixed an issue that caused reputation rewards to display incorrectly after completing a War or Invasion.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Influence Race results screen to not properly display Influence defended.
 Fixed an issue where the client could become soft-locked if the In-game Store purchasing flow inside the Steam Overlay was cancelled with the ESC key.
 Fixed an issue where Fort locks would not display on the Fort capture point flag.
 Fixed a loading screen that wasn't displaying an image, resulting in a white screen.
 Fixed an issue that could cause improper size scaling of the Tradeskill XP flyout wheel.
 Fixed an issue that could cause personal map markers to either not register or become displaced from their desired location. 
 Fixed an issue where the Player Info panel was misaligned against other players' info on the Invasion Results screen. 
 Fixed an issue that could improperly order a pinned quest's objectives if the objectives were location based.

SEASONS

 Fixed an issue that caused players to get two credits for killing a named objective (ex: Kill 10 beasts).
 Fixed a typo in the title of the "Faction Family" Season Journey task.
 Fixed an issue that prevented the "Salvage Tier 5 Items" Season Activity from progressing when salvaging Umbral Shards.
 Fixed an issue that prevented Flail kills from contributing toward Season Activities that require kills with a one handed weapon.
 Fixed an issue that caused Season Pass Items to become unclaimable.
 Fixed a Season Activity that had listed an incorrect target objective, updating directions from "Kill enemies in Malevolence" to "Kill enemies in Tor Mallacht".

COMMUNITY MOUNT SHOWCASE
We asked you to share your best mount images in celebration of the new feature. Here are some of our favorites:

SEUJUZE - DEVALOKA
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/2LO6zjtbmTkIbL1T27rWOD/31a56e7a9d077b3f62a116b023b5ae73/SeuJuze_-_Devaloka_1920.jpg
BENEFALL - DEVALOKA
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/2EDLOuA4TbruPLqJrOtCbY/d26e48a53441da80933ec27a18809c83/Benefall_-_Devaloka_1920.jpg
FREEEGYPTIAN - LILITH
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/5LrnXsNZAv3Kx5Qpm3aywY/dbf97ae89ba6b4d1f5a90d87d6901be7/FreeEgyptian_-_Lilith_1920.jpg
POZIOMICA - BARRI
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/4UkOCEQv2X8NAI0ZRbfrEF/56e93d11ee7602aedac5162986f95b1d/Poziomica_-_Barri_1920.jpg
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World Update 2.0.5
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6vsPp2QL69kR8UvhGoQznF/8104d8d9b8394a8c0bbe38b46ef832cc/NW_RemnantCombat_EggcitingEvent_S2Announce_1920x1080_Final_CT-001711.jpg
Greetings, Adventurers!

New World Update 2.0.5 downtime will begin at 11:00PM PT (6:00AM UTC) on September 12 and last approximately 1 hour. It includes an extension to the Siege of Sulfur event, plus Transmog fixes. Check out the full list of changes below.

SIEGE OF SULFUR
The Siege of Sulfur event will be extended until October 3rd. 

 We recognize that the event's launch didn't go as smoothly as we had anticipated and are dedicated to improving the overall experience through additional fixes. In light of the difficulties that have affected completion and enjoyment, we have made the decision to extend the event. We hope that this extension will provide players with a better opportunity to fully experience the encounter and its unique rewards over the next few weeks.
 Fixed an issue that prevented progress in the Brimstone Sands Siege of Sulfur encounter.

TRANSMOG FIXES

 Fixed a Transmog issue that prevented players from capturing item appearances until after they logged out and back in.
 Fixed a Transmog issue caused players to lose item Dyes on equipment if there was an error during application.
 Fixed an issue that caused Leaderboards to display in the incorrect section of the Transmog window.
 Fixed an issue with the Desecrated Leather Gloves skin.

3V3 ARENAS

 The Brimstone Sands Gladiatorial Pit will remain active in the 3v3 Arenas map rotation for 3 additional weeks.

GENERAL

 Players with temporary bans will no longer see a generic login error when starting the game. They will now see an error popup that describes their ban.
 Fixed an issue that caused the wrong Gear Set Storage icon to appear in the menu.
 Fixed an issue that caused certain rushing and warring crafting patterns to roll gem slots incorrectly.
 Fixed an issue that caused Player Titles to appear on Nameplates during Outpost Rush.

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World September Dev Update
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/2xQZh2V7296kxg0GKD5331/8e69a8370eb956933b8bcb637a6f61ce/Screengrab_01_Team_Update_Title_1920x1080.jpg
Greetings, Adventurers!

We’re thrilled to dig into the details of our first expansion, Rise of the Angry Earth, in the September Dev Update. Join us for a discussion of every new feature including mounts and Elysian Wilds, plus conversations around Season 3 updates like Influence Races. Discover the next chapter of Aeternum in the video below.

[previewyoutube=P0fDWDP49Gg;full][/previewyoutube]
The video will be sectioned by topic on YouTube, so if you’re only interested in checking out certain subjects, you’ll easily be able to navigate to them. Here’s an overview of the topics included in this month’s update.

VIDEO SUMMARY
RISE OF THE ANGRY EARTH
Ride mounts through transformed lands when New World: Rise of the Angry Earth launches on October 3. We can’t wait for players to experience every new feature in our first paid expansion:

 Mounts
 New Weapon: Flail
 New Gear Rarity: Artifacts
 New Story
 New Progression
 A Zone Transformed: Elysian Wilds
 New Expedition: The Savage Divide
 New Heartrune Ability: Primal Fury

Check out our announcement article for more details, including an FAQ.

SEASON 3
Look forward to Season 3 updates for all players alongside the release of Rise of the Angry Earth. With revamped mainline story quests, open world PvP changes based on player feedback, and quality of life improvements like the removal of Wards, Banes and Expertise, there has never been a better time to visit the Eternal Isle. Explore the official announcement for a full breakdown of what to expect.

PTR
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/7cUfxH7a44qczGreduPH2/f344243de049844e0501d9a46bb5f953/NW_OldFirstLight_ROTAE_Announce_1920x1080_Final_CT-002143.jpg
Stay tuned to our website and social media channels for updates on when the Rise of the Angry Earth and Season 3 PTR will be available. Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World Update 2.0.4
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1np4ufNISBdpdIbX2QJPkE/313cb8d7957f45b789c4841239c35dd0/Liv_Winde_-_Devaloka_1920.jpg
Greetings, Adventurers!

Updated on 9/12:
The Siege of Sulfur event will be extended until October 3rd.

 We recognize that the event's launch didn't go as smoothly as we had anticipated and are dedicated to improving the overall experience through additional fixes. In light of the difficulties that have affected completion and enjoyment, we have made the decision to extend the event. We hope that this extension will provide players with a better opportunity to fully experience the encounter and its unique rewards over the next few weeks.

New World Update 2.0.4 downtime will begin at 11:00PM PT (6:00AM UTC) on August 29 and last approximately 2 hours. As the final portals close on Luck of the Bones, a new danger descends upon Aeternum. Defend sandwurm eggs in the Siege of Sulfur event for a Mini-Devourer hat skin, sandwurm egg housing item, and more.

You can also check out the upcoming store catalogue in our first showcase video, plus Transmog bug fixes, a new community spotlight on fashion, and the August Q&A.

SIEGE OF SULFUR
Team up with 10+ max-level players to defend sandwurm eggs from waves of Sulfur Elementals for limited-time, sandwurm themed rewards on August 30 through September 12. You’ll also earn rewards that will help you defeat Shah Neshen. How will you stop the Siege of Sulfur?

Explore our announcement article for more details.

STORE SHOWCASE
There is a constant swirl in the balance between light and shadow, the real and the void. Take your stand and look for new apparel, weapon and emote bundles in the store throughout September. These items can be obtained individually or as part of a bundle in exchange for Marks of Fortune. Here’s a preview of what to expect:

[previewyoutube=MnI4QfQGI30;full][/previewyoutube]
RELEASE NOTES
CLIENT PERFORMANCE

 We previously capped the number of sounds in high-density player scenarios. These limits were bypassed when developing new content which reduced the game client performance in any scenario with more than five players. Most players should now see improved client performance during PVP and heavy PVE game modes as a result of reinstituting those audio limits.

QUESTS

 The proper Samuel Worthington Bloodgood III will now be visible for the Stalk of Shame quest turn in.

TRANSMOG

 Updated the icons for the Corrupted Dynasty Longsword and Musket at the Stylemancer.
 Players with female character models will now see updated the icons for Thorpe's Helm, Prime Light Headwear and Yezariael's Visage when viewed at the Stylemancer.
 Updated icons for several items including Bear Bones Medium set, Vagabond Light Handwear, Breach Void Gauntlet and Corrupted Orichalcum Ice Gauntlet.
 Updated Transmog error messages to show which skin is not being applied, either because there is no item in that slot, or that skin is already applied.

SPEAR

 Invigorating Crits - added a 0.1s cooldown to prevent it from triggering more than once per attack.
 Invigorating Combo - Reduced target limit from 4 to 2, so now it can only trigger 2 activations per use.

PVP ARENAS

 Improved 3v3 Arenas queue to more quickly get players into pre-match games that need additional Adventurers.

NOTABLE FIXES

 Fixed an issue that prevented trophy buffs from being applied and allowed some decorations to be placed more times than intended.
 Fixed an issue that caused a placeholder in the Crafting Station list upon first login.
 Fixed an issue with the Transmog preview when previewing gloves while using an Ice or Void Gauntlet would result in your right forearm turning invisible until you exited the Stylemancer screen.
 Fixed an issue that allowed other players to appear when using the Stylemancer/Change Skin menu.
 Fixed an issue that caused some skins to not show a proper tool tip in the Transmog window.
 Fixed an issue that allowed players to gain more experience than intended after bulk leveling Trade Skills.
 Fixed a visual issue with some roofs throughout Aeternum.
 Fixed an issue that caused Golden Scarab crafts to incorrectly count toward Season Challenges.

KNOWN ISSUES

 Voice chat may briefly stop working while on the respawn screen.
 Voice chat may stop working upon joining a group or when entering/leaving an instance like Expeditions, 3v3 Arenas, and Outpost Rush.

COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT
We asked you to share your best Transmog images in celebration of the new feature. Here are some of our favorites:

LIV WINDE - DEVALOKA
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1np4ufNISBdpdIbX2QJPkE/313cb8d7957f45b789c4841239c35dd0/Liv_Winde_-_Devaloka_1920.jpg
MISAKI
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/5qYJiAOmwO5nazCflvhb2R/c5ee32b62f5fc098a89eab527a5ece8c/Misaki_1920.jpg
YE XIU - MARAMMA
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6zAXHWOkOG3GgR82lqH0Fp/8e98b733468f56fc87438ce4ca3eb5ac/YE_XIU_-_Marrama_1920.jpg
QUEENKIT - ISABELLA
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/4sAgYtel62yI1Y2WnHEAcT/f823a00187e12d980a65aee5fd23787a/QueenKit_-_Isabella_1920.jpg
COMMUNITY Q&A
Join the Development Team for our latest monthly Q&A session featuring your most common questions from Discord, Reddit, and YouTube. Topic include the expansion, desyncs, perk changes, and more.

[previewyoutube=iWpMmeKEnlE;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

LUCK OF THE BONES

 Fixed an issue that prevented all types of treasure chests that are fished up from progressing the Treasures of the Deep quest.

notes.title: New World Update 2.0.2
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/7h5BkUm3Mxxb4gxfjwqeGz/a9fb38af08f5aab88a923de75d75e16e/NW_GroupFishing_Medleyfaire_S2Announce_1920x1080_Final_CT-001711.jpg

Greetings, Adventurers!

New World Update 2.0.2 downtime will begin at 4:00AM PT (11:00AM UTC) on August 3 and last approximately 1.5 hours. It includes fixes to framerates, the sandwurm Elite Trial, and more. Read on for a full breakdown of the performance changes.

PERFORMANCE CHANGES

 We have implemented a performance change to the way shaders are loaded on the game client. This change is expected to enhance the overall gameplay experience by reducing instances of frame-hitching and stuttering. However, it's important to note that there will be a noticeable impact on game boot-up time as a trade-off.
 The new start-up time will vary depending on your local hardware setup, with less delays experienced on SSD hard drives and longer delays on HDDs.
 During this process, your client will remain on the initial New World logo screen for up to a minute as it front-loads necessary assets. We kindly ask for your patience while you experience this new personal start time benchmark.
 We will closely monitor player feedback and telemetry on client performance after this change, in search of further opportunities for optimization.
 Fixed a number of server crashes that disconnected players with a “Lag Detected” error.

COMBAT

 Fixed an issue that allowed players to end the recovery of the Blunderbuss ability “Splitting Grenade” early.
 Increased the amount of health players gain from the first 150 levels of Constitution attribute points.
 Swapped the 150 DEX and 300 DEX attribute threshold bonuses with each other.
 The Detonate Heartrune is no longer able to deal Critical damage.
 Reduced the strength of the Spear’s “Cyclone” slow effect, from 50% to 30%.
 Limited the number of targets that could be affected by the Spear’s “Leeching Cyclone” Perk in a single use to 3.
 Reworked the Sword's “Achille's Heel” passive to instead be a Rend.

ELITE SANDWURM TRIAL

 Fixed an issue that caused players who died during the encounter to not receive rewards upon completion.

ECONOMY, PROGRESSION, AND GEAR

 Fixed an issue that made Legendary Fish far easier to catch than intended.
 Introduced hotkeys for Gear Set Storage. You can now specify hotkeys that will swap your current loadout to a specific Gear Set Storage loadout.
 Fixed an issue that made the Artisan Fishing Pole unusable.

SEASON PASS

 Fixed an issue that caused the Earn PvP XP Season Activity to display incorrect text.
 Fixed an issue that caused Season XP awarded from crafting Gypsum Casts to not scale correctly when crafting multiple casts at once.
 Fixed an issue that prevented players who did not earn a Gear Set Slot through the Season 1 Season Pass from purchasing it through the Store.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Journey task “Call of the Ancients” to not properly record song completion.

SEASON TRIALS

 Fixed an issue that caused the Hordemaster boss to spawn less monsters than intended.
 Fixed an issue that caused a large gray plane to be visible within the arena space.
 Fixed an issue that caused long load times for some Seasonal content.

QUESTS

 During the “Break Some Eggs” quest, it is now no longer necessary to travel to the Neopolis as the Hatchery Soul Trial immediately unlocks after applying oil.
 Reduced enemy health and damage in the “Break Some Eggs” Soul Trial.
 NPC "Spawned Guy" no longer spawns in the world.
 Removed lingering missions from Old First Light as that zone is no longer accessible due to the Angry Earth.

GAME MODES

 Increased the amount of personal score points gained from contesting outpost control points by 40% in Outpost Rush.
 3v3 Arenas - The Brimstone Sands Arena has been activated once again as part of the 2-week rotation. It will remain active until 8/15/23 when the original Soulwarden's Proving Ground Arena will be activated.

UX/UI

 Fixed an issue where Minstrel Pattern items could not be crafted even though you had the materials.
 Fixed a rare issue that prevented players from accessing their Season Journey and Activities.
 Fixed a texture loading issue that caused the chat window to become white.
 Fixed an issue that caused chat channel tooltips to be incorrect.
 Fixed an issue that made localized text on Faction Boards incorrect when no PvP missions were available.

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World Update 2.0.1
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/5Yd3JpQtKQECMVn3k48NFx/cdf0b5114ca6234d73edf26422dfe980/NW_RuggedRespite_1920x1080_Final_CT-002119.jpg
Greetings, Adventurers!

New World Update 2.0.1 downtime will begin at 11:00PM PT (6:00AM UTC) on July 18 and last approximately 1 hour. Celebrate the Summer Medleyfaire with new songs and rewards at Summer Villages throughout Aeternum. This update also includes additional store items, plus various bug fixes.

Join the New World Discord and share your favorite images from the event for a chance to be featured on our website.

SUMMER MEDLEYFAIRE
The Summer Medleyfaire returns with new songs and rewards like a Guitar Hero title. Every seasonal activity is back, including the Aeternum Sturgeon — a highly sought after fish prized by both anglers and cooks alike! Visit Summer Villages, raise your reputation with the Medleyfaire Maestro, and net any seasonal items you may have missed from last year. The festivities will run from July 19 until August 15. Check out the full announcement for more details.

RELEASE NOTES
WORLD EXPERIENCE

 Fixed an issue that caused players to get stuck in the quest “Temple of Sands" when abandoning it.
 Fixed an incorrect quest task description that said "Go to the Temple of Shu" instead of describing a crafting task.
 Fixed an issue that blocked progression if you died in the breather phases of the solo Hatchery.
 Fixed an issue in the quest “The Vigil's Truth” that prevented players from repeating the grave portion upon reset.
 The Denier in Weaver's Fen now counts toward any Faction quests that require his defeat regardless of the player's Faction.
 Fixed an issue that blocked players from continuing into Shattered Mountain if they immediately traveled to Brimstone Sands after completing the quest “A Selfless Nature”.
 Fixed an issue that caused structures in the POI Castrum Perdita to appear in the incorrect position.
 Fixed an issue that caused the player to enter a bad state when catching a rare fish in Mourningdale.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Disk of Atum encounter to break, preventing progression on the quest “The Demon’s Caulron”.

SEASONS

 Updated visible collision with Arena walls in the Season 2 Trials.
 Fixed an issue with a visual issue with an NPC that played the guitar.
 Fixed an issue with the Passion for Prismabloom Journey task that caused it to not specify the type of Prismabloom needed to progress (Desert Rose Prismabloom).
 Replaced placeholder text on the tooltip for Trophy of Blood of the Sands.
 Fixed an issue that caused a mismatched name for the Buckler of the Briar Rose between the skin and the reward track.
 Fixed issue that caused the Journey task “Call of the Ancients” to not properly record song completion.
 Fixed an issue that would prevent Hadish Azar from properly using his wipe move when all players are downed while in the Hatchery.
 Fixed an issue that was preventing players from being able to access their Season Journey and Activities Card in the UI.

ECONOMY, PROGRESSION, & GEAR

 Fixed an issue that prevented players who did not earn the Level 100 Season 1 Pass Reward from purchasing the unearned Gear Set Slot in the store.
 Gypsum Casts for Shields are now Epic rarity to match the rarity of the possible reward.

COMBAT CHANGES

 Fixed an issue that caused the Dodge and Weave passive haste buff to persist when the player swapped weapons mid dodge.
 Fixed an issue with the Detonate Heartrune's explosion VFX so that it remains visible in high-density combat areas.

UI/UX/SOCIAL

 Fixed a rare issue that prevented players from leaving their group.
 Fixed an issue that caused Azoth staff VFX to get stuck on weapons if the player was damaged while closing a Corruption Portal.
 Fixed a typo in the description for the quest "Heir to the Sands."
 Fixed an issue that caused a white UI box to appear during musical performances.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Skip button on the Summary screen presented at the end of an Invasion to become non-functional.
 "Friendship Accepted" notifications for existing friends will no longer appear when entering Outpost Rush.

GAME MODE UPDATES

 Backfill for PvP Arenas is now more responsive, making it more likely for players in the queue to get into pre-match games.

NEW STORE ITEMS
The Frontier Wastelander Store Showcase is live now through October 3, but additional items are coming to the in-game store. These items can be obtained individually or as part of a bundle in exchange for Marks of Fortune.

RUGGED RESPITE - CAMP SKIN
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/5Yd3JpQtKQECMVn3k48NFx/cdf0b5114ca6234d73edf26422dfe980/NW_RuggedRespite_1920x1080_Final_CT-002119.jpg
“Take shelter from the storms of dust and blood alike.”
Cost: 20,000 Marks of Fortune

EMOTIVE BUNDLE - EMOTES
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/7m9NBLVBpZGyMTTW0BL5wF/01e8907896e38814f55ecd8386d1dd56/EN_NW_EmoteBundle_1920x1080.jpg
“How are you feeling?”
Includes:

 Pondering Emote
 Plotting Emote
 Pout Emote
 Eyes on You Emote
 Cry Emote
 Whistle Emote

Cost: 9,000 Marks of Fortune

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

BRIMSTONE SANDS

 Brimstone Sands is unlocked for everyone as of Update 1.9.4. Players of all levels can now travel to Brimstone Sands without dying to the sun (scorpions and sandwurms are a different story). We apologize for letting this patch note burrow away from us in the previous article.

NOTABLE FIXES

 Fixed an issue that caused Yonas to not appear for players that had not completed The Ritual quest before the Brimstone Sands Release.
 Fixed an issue with Yonas' idle animation.

notes.title: Season 2 PTR Wave 2.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers!

Before Wave 3 of the Season 2 PTR launches, we will address some Sandwurm and Hatchery bugs for a smoother player experience. Downtime will begin at 10:00AM PT on June 13 and last approximately 90 minutes.

If you encounter a bug, exploit, or have suggestions to improve a feature or piece of content, we’d love to hear your feedback on our Discord (you can also utilize our in-game feedback tool). We will do our best to address as much of your feedback as possible before the content update makes its way to our live servers. Your participation will help us to deliver awesome content and updates in the future!

World Experience


 Added collision planes around all areas where players could jump off of the ledge into rock chasms during the Legacy of the Sands Soul Trial.

Combat/AI

 Fixed a bug that prevented the acid clouds during the submerge phase of the Sandwurm fight from consistently affecting players. 
 Fixed a bug that prevented the Sandwurm's stacking empower, applied at the end of every phase cycle, from affecting its acid based attacks.
 Addressed an issue that caused max health to not properly increase with the removal of Hale and Hearty when adding attributes into CON.

Game Modes

 Fixed an issue that caused consumables in PvP Arena to appear greyed out, and unusable, even though their cooldown was complete.

Economy, Progression, and Gear


 All items from the Daily Reward Cache should now raise expertise as expected.
 The Artisan Hatchet and Spear are now craftable at the Forge instead of the Workshop.
 Sandwurm replicas are now craftable at the correct crafting stations.

Seasons

 Fixed an issue that caused players to not receive previous Season Pass rewards when logging in.
 Fixed a typo in the "Mutation God" title.
 Weapon skins on the season pass rewards track now correctly display that they are skins in their tooltips.

Season Trials


 Removed the ability to Stoneform out of the Explosive Sulfur Core.
 Increased the damage dealt by Incinerate by 56%.
 Incinerate now applies slight knockback on impact.

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: Season 2 - PTR Wave 2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1dA2shPbyqSahsSBYrfqpD/3bf7bf6304278e402acd4c749c7a1b6a/NW_BloodStainedSkin_MSQ_S2Announce_1920x1080_Final_CT-001711.jpg

Greetings, Adventurers!

Get ready for Aeternum’s greatest challenge yet and an all-new event in wave 2 of the Blood of the Sands PTR. 

If you encounter a bug, exploit, or have suggestions to improve a feature or piece of content, we’d love to hear your feedback on our Discord (you can also utilize our in-game feedback tool). We will do our best to address as much of your feedback as possible before the content update makes its way to our live servers. Your participation will help us to deliver awesome content and updates in the future!

During this wave of the PTR, we look forward to hearing your playtest feedback on the following changes:

Release 2:

 Sandwurm Trial 
 Siege of Sulfur

Check out an in-depth breakdown of the update in our official announcement and stay tuned to our social channels for updates. You can also find more information on the previous PTR Patch Notes in our Wave 1 article.

To help players in the PTR in testing our new Elite Trial we have included a Status Effect available through the backstory. This simulates the bonuses players would experience in Live against Beasts with 3x Major Wildlife Combat Trophies. This does not stack with placed Trophies.

World Experience
Quests

 The Runed Haft, the Staff Head, and the Angry Earth Seed will now disappear from the player’s inventory when they are not on a quest that specifically needs or uses them.
 Once the player has collected enough scrolls for the quest A Curious Child, additional scrolls will no longer appear collectable.
 Scrolls are now easier to spot  at Shattered Obelisk for the quest A Curious Child.
 There's a tower door that is unlocked during the quest Hope Springs Eternal at Skyview Repose. Once opened, this door will now remain unlocked forever, allowing players to return for any chests they may have missed after the quest.

Notable Fixes

 Fixed an issue that caused players to teleport under their house after recalling.
 Fixed an issue that caused Smelter Chimneys to not animate when the player spawned into the area.
 Fixed an issue in the quest Guardians’ Secrets that created an extra empty bullet point.
 Removed a Grey Box from the First Light wall.

General

 Reduced the collision height on the Brimstone Sands settlement bridges.

Expeditions 
General

 Fixed an issue in some Expeditions that caused particle effects to appear larger than intended.

The Depths

 Fixed an issue that prevented multiple players from looting Thorpe's key.
 Reduced the health of Apocalypse Mines in Mutator mode.

AI

 Revised Expedition Elite enemies to remove pushback applied from player attacks that don't cause a stagger (Ex - light attacks)
 Fixed an issue that caused Grunts to not move toward players when attacked from a distance.

Game Modes

Outpost Rush

 Fixed a UI alignment issue with the Corrupted Portal Timer.

War

 Fixed an issue that caused the attackers in War to not be able to purchase siege weapons.

3v3 Arenas

 Players will no longer hear the Announcer voice lines like, "I'll dredge up a few more challengers, Let's wait, there's no challenge in an uneven fight or do I have any eager spectators who wish to try their luck" when waiting to start matches.

ECONOMY, PROGRESSION, & GEAR
Notable Fixes

 Fixed an issue that prevented the Azoth Staff from maxing out its tier at Legendary.
 Fixed an issue that prevented players from getting max rank tokens.
 Fixed an issue that allowed inapplicable Craft Mods to be selectable on Fishing Poles.
 Fixed an issue that caused crafted Winter Convergence items to lack event tags.

General

 Doubled the cap for Faction tokens at all levels. The new cap at maximum reputation with your Faction is now 150,000.
 Renamed Old Jewelry to Exemplary Jewelry and added a description.
 Weaver's Fen Faction Control Bonus has been changed from "-10% Global Tax Value" to "+10% Global Refining Yield". This was previously assigned to First Light.

Base Weight Weapon Changes
Changed the base weight of the following weapons:

 Swords to 3.
 Rapiers to 2.5.
 Hatchets to 4.
 Greatswords to 8.5.
 Hammers to 8.5.
 Great Axes to 8.
 Spears to 6.
 Bows to 6.
 Muskets to 7.
 Blunderbuss to 7.
 Fire Staffs to 7.
 Life Staffs to 7.
 Ice Gauntlets to 3.
 Void Gauntlets to 3.

Gear Changes

Equipment items that drop in the world of Aeternum have been updated to use new perk buckets based on content types. Players should no longer see perks like Resilient, Family Wards, and Banes dropping together on gear. Following these changes:

 You can now replace Gems in Invasion and Breach Closer Trinkets
 Fixed some inconsistencies in the way some families of AI rolled perks when providing loot. All AI families should now roll loot more consistently.

Corrupted Breaches rewards have also been updated with new armor and weapons:

 These new items are guaranteed to always roll 1 Family Bane or Ward perk when dropped for players, and use the appearances of previous Corruption Breach items.
 The old armor and weapons will no longer drop.
 New Elite items can now drop, plus Family Bane/Ward perk crafting mods.

Updated the following Named Equipment that drops from Corrupted Breaches:

 Ice Gauntlet, Glacial Rage - Updated to always drop at 590 Gear Score, Kind swapped to Pylon Burst, and added a 5th perk, Keenly Empowered.
 Longsword, Moonless Night - Mortal Lifesteal swapped to Human Bane
 War Hammer, Portalsmasher - Mortal Lifesteal swapped to Enchanted
 Fire Staff, Flames of the Breach - Mortal Fortification swapped to Empowering Incinerate, Keenly Fortified swapped to Keenly Empowered
 Great Axe, Dark of Night - Mortal Lifesteal swapped to Keenly Jagged
 Rapier, When They Come - Mortal Fortification swapped to Keenly Jagged
 Musket, Breach Bloodied Rifle - Mortal Lifesteal swapped to Refreshing Power Shot
 Ice Gauntlet, Frostbitten Mitt - Siphoning Blow swapped to Unbroken Winds, and Mortal Refreshment swapped to Keenly Jagged
 Added a new Tier 5 Blunderbuss, Cannonade, that can drop from Corruption Breaches.
 The previous versions of these items will remain unchanged in the player’s inventory.

Season Pass

 Crafting with Infused Orbs at the Gypsum Kiln will now grant small amounts of seasonal XP.
 Fixed an issue that allowed any song to complete the "Call of the Ancients" Season Journey task.

UX/UI 
Notable Fixes

 Fixed an issue that caused the exit button to not work after renaming a character in the Main Menu.
 Fixed an issue with the alignment of the play button on the 3v3 Arenas tab.
 Fixed a typo in the Silver and Gold Ingot descriptions.
 Fixed an issue where flagging for PvP caused the notification to move on top of pinned Quests in the HUD.
 Fixed an issue where the Lock Icon in the inventory was too low of a resolution.
 Fixed an issue with Main Story Quest icons were not prioritized over other quest icons when zooming out of a settlement on the map.
 Fixed an issue with low resolution icons associated with emotes on the PvP Tracker.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Crafting Trade Skill milestone banner to show the recipe result instead of the recipe name.
 Fixed an issue that caused the map pin to disappear on the quest Adiana's Fountain, if the second and third tasks were completed, but not the first.
 Fixed an issue that prevented visuals from appearing on interactable objects.
 Fixed the item type tooltip for the Artisan Shield.
 Fixed the item type tooltip for the Artisan Greataxe.

General

 Swapped the schematic icon on weapon schematic recipe items. It is now a blank schematic icon to reduce confusion for players.
 Increased Musket reticle marker speed to improve clarity during chaotic battles.
 Improved pinning for the target POI in the quest 'Down Payment'.

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: Season 2 - Blood of the Sands: PTR Release Notes
notes.notes:
Get ready for new PvP activities, narratives, and a massive sand wurm when Season 2 - Blood of the Sands releases on July 6. Want an early taste of what to expect? Join the PTR!

If you encounter a bug, exploit, or have suggestions to improve a feature or piece of content, we’d love to hear your feedback on our Discord (you can also utilize our in-game feedback tool). We will do our best to address as much of your feedback as possible before the content update makes its way to our live servers. Your participation will help us to deliver awesome content and updates in the future!

During this iteration of the PTR, we look forward to hearing your playtest feedback on the following changes. These features will be tested in rolling waves:

Release 1:

 Summer Medleyfaire
 New 3v3 Arena Map
 First Light Retraction
 Season 2 Narrative
 Rewards Track
 Season 2 Trials
 Outpost Rush Refresh
 Raid Groups

Release 2:

 Sandwurm Trial
 Siege of Sulfur

Release 3:

 Cross-World OPR

Check out an in-depth breakdown of the update in our official announcement and stay tuned to our social channels for updates.

World Experience

Quests

 Resolved an issue with how the Lore page for the quest The Pirate’s Problem triggered. 
 Fixed a mismatch in capitalization for the quest A Toymakers Request.
 Resolved an issue that caused the quest pin for the quest The Curse of Karburg to not appear if players are outside of the quest area.
 Resolved an issue where players sometimes were unable to progress the quest Best Foot Forwards.
 Resolved an issue where players sometimes were unable to complete the quest Famela’s Wrath after crafting the firer staff at an Arcane Repository.
 Fixed the chest issue for the Abandoned Duties quest in Mourningdale by making a quest-specific chest that only appears once the player is at that location, which contains the telescope they are required to recover.
 Added additional gators to the Zander the Undying quest.
 Moved Corrupted Portal to properly block Elite Chest in Myrkgard.
 Improved the cannons that you can use to access caves blocked by fallen debris.
 Resolved an issue where PvP missions would not reset after players recalled back to town.
 Added rocks to steep terrain near camp in Corsair's Rise.
 Resolved an issue where Aethelwynn would disappear after abandoning the quest Music to Her Ears.


Brimstone Sands

 Fixed a visual issue on the map which removed unnecessary landmarks near Brimstone Sands.
 Fixed an issue where Ancient Murals in Brimstone Sands weren't visible on the map.
 The player animation for playing the Brimstone drum is in sync with other players and the drumming audio.
 Moved Warden Reaver in Hermopois POI so he's no longer inside terrain.


Notable Fixes

 Fixed an issue that made some sections of the Genesis and Depths Expeditions darker than intended.
 Fixed an issue where the icon for Fallswatch Overlook in Windsward appeared misplaced on the map.
 Fixed an issue that caused the revive prompt to appear while downed in deep deep water when a revive was not possible.
 Fixed an issue that would allow players to clip through the ground in Weaver's Fen and die.
 Fixed loot container placement in Castrum Victualis POI so it no longer clips into nearby crates.
 Fixed Rivercrest interaction in Monarch's Bluff territory.
 Fixed an issue where some of the cliff was missing in Old Myrkgard Forest.

Expeditions
The Depths

 Fixed an issue that allowed Captain Thorpe to hit players behind him.

Tempest’s Heart

 Increased visibility of AOE attack range for Neishatun.
 Fixed an issue that caused Neishatun to become unresponsive after spawning.
 Fixed an issue that caused the tether link between Isabella and the cultists to not appear in the Fallen Chandeliers fight.
 Fixed an issue where points were not deducted when failing a boss encounter.
 Fixed issue where Ironwood tree was not awarding points in Mutated mode.

Empyrean Forge

 Fixed an issue that caused Ice Pylon to sometimes target meteors from Ifrit's attacks.

Barnacles & Black Powder

 Fixed an issue that caused caged Alligators to retreat back into their cages after disengaging an enemy.
 Fixed an issue that caused players to respawn at the entrance instead of the final checkpoint.

Garden of Genesis

 Fixed an issue that caused the Blighted Greenskeeper's poison pool to spawn in the air.

Lazarus Instrumentality

 Fixed an issue that caused the objective to not update properly if the player was already in the Bath House upon completion.

Starstone Barrows

 Updated icon text to match objective text.

AI Updates
World AI

 Fixed an issue that caused Brimstone Sulfur Dragons to not regen stamina after retreating.
 Fixed an issue that caused Osiris enemies to not regen stamina after retreating.
 Fixed an issue that allowed Evil Knight Commanders to kill the player at Death's Door with an explosive mine.
 Fixed an issue that allowed players to safely attack the Siren Brute in the Spire of Melpomene from specific locations.
 Fixed an issue that caused some Teyrnon Knights' Shields in the Teyrnon Keep POI to not appear correctly.
 Fixed an animation of a Reedgill Retcher in Monarch's Bluffs.
 Fixed an issue that caused Blighted Greenskeeper's boulder attack warning to not appear.
 Fixed a duplicate spawn issue for Sir Juni. This Elite Named AI should only spawn on the vessel docked at Attalus's Foundry.
 Fixed an issue that caused Highlands Signifer's weapon and Shield to disappear while patrolling.

Combat Changes

General


 Fixed an issue where Flare and Mortar Charge AOEs were not dealing stamina damage to blocking players.
 Increased player base HP across all levels by 10%. NOTE: This change was made to compensate for the removal of the hale and and hearty town buff.
 Increased value of the non-combat 300 INT attribute bonus from 10% to 25% to give it slightly more value.
 Players now leave combat 1 second after killing the final enemy in an engagement.
 Reduced default in combat timer to 10 seconds from 20 seconds.
 Made it so the player is no longer Slowed if they become exhausted by being block broken.

New Blocking Functionality

 Added new blocking functionality that allows non-shield weapons to mitigate a portion of a ranged attack's damage while blocking.

One-handed Weapons 

 When blocking ranged attacks, 50% of the ranged attack damage will penetrate the block. Stamina damage will be reduced when this occurs. 

Two-handed Weapons 

 When blocking ranged attacks, 30% of the ranged attack damage will penetrate the block. Stamina damage will be reduced when this occurs. 

Magic weapons 

 When blocking ranged attacks, 40% of the ranged attack damage will penetrate the block. Stamina damage will be reduced when this occurs. 

Shields 

 Remain unchanged. Blocking melee or ranged attacks mitigates 100% of the attack damage.
 Slightly increased base movement speed while blocking. (Increased from 1.65 to 2.0 meters per second)

Weapons
Blunderbuss

 Fixed an issue where Net Shot could apply status effects to targets that were Riposting and blocking.
 Fixed an issue where some blunderbuss status effects were being improperly removed while traversing the world.
 Fixed an issue where the Blunderbuss could grant all stacks of the Empowering Breaker Perk in a single shot.
 Fixed an issue where the Blunderbuss passive Extended Chamber could sometimes grant ammo after shots were fired.
 Fixed an issue where the Runeglass DoTs and various other "on hit" bonuses were triggered from the impact of splitting grenade. Now they should only trigger off of the explosion.

Blast Shot
 
 Increased range by 1m

Bow

 Fixed an issue where the player would be in a broken state after exiting Outpost Rush while aiming with a bow
 Fixed an issue where the Impale Bow passive could trigger off of DoTs.
 Fixed an issue where players were unable to use a potion or eat food when starting to sprint while using a bow.

Rain Of Arrows
 
 Increased bleed damage from the barbed arrows upgrade from 7.1% to 15%,
 Reduced cooldown from 25s to 20s.
 Reduced the time it takes from the arrows to be shot into the air to when the attack lands.
 Increased radius from 3m to 4m.

Dodge and Weave Passive 

 Updated functionality to only trigger while at full stamina.

Knee Shot 

  Renamed to Rending Headshot and changed the functionality from slow on leg shot to 10% rend for 3s on headshot. Also moved into the location of the Evasive Tactics passive.

Evasive Tactics 
 
 Swapped out to be the ultimate in place of knee shot. (This will cause a force respec of the bow mastery tree)

Fire Staff

 Fixed an issue where the Meteor Shower Perk combined with Runeglass DoT gems Perks granted players more stacks than intended.
 Fixed an issue where Flare wasn't dealing the correct amount of stamina damage to blocking targets.
 Fixed an issue where two "Blocked" flyouts would appear on a blocked hit.
 Fixed an issue where the Meteor Shower Perk with Watch It Burn passive granted players more stacks than intended

Incinerate
  
 Increased damage from 150% to 175%.
 Reduced the recovery of the attack.

Pillar of Fire
   
 Reduced damage from 165% to 155%.

Great Axe
Execute 

  Adjusted the timing to make the hitbox appear 2 frames later and last 2 additional frames.
  Reduced cooldown from 25s to 20s

Whirlwind

 Moved up block and dodge cancel windows to be after the first spin instead of 2nd spin.
 Increased movement speed while active by 15%
 Increased rotation speed of whirlwind by 20%.

Reap

 Increased first hit damage from 60% to 80%.

Greatsword

 Fixed an issue where Greatsword stance status effects could be incorrectly removed while traversing

Roaring Rupture
   
 Increased the power of the Fortify from 8% to 10% per stack, and increased duration from 5s to 7s.

Skyward Slash

Hatchet

Infected Throw

 Aerial Transmission Upgrade

Rending Throw
  
 Increased Rend power from 10% to 20%.

Raging Torrent

Social Distancing

Ice Gauntlet
Ice Pylon

Windchill
    
 Moved Grit from the Perk to being on the base ability.
 Increased Windchill's damage from 20% to 24% weapon damage per tick.

Life Staff

Splash of Light
    
 Reduced Radius from 100m to 25m (So range is consistent with other Life Staff healing)

  Splash of Light Shared Recovery Upgrade
   Increased mana gain from 5% to 15%

Musket

 Updated Musket crosshair to make it easier to see during combat.
Power Shot and Powder Burn Upgrades
   
 These abilities no longer require a dedicated reload allowing them to be activated during many other actions including Shooters Stance.

Sword & Shield

 Fixed an issue where the Sword's Leaping Strike ability could go on cooldown without being used if the ability button was pressed at the same time as a basic attack.
 The named Sword, Coral Lash, is being updated. It should now have the same base offensive stats as other Tier 5 Swords, and has the Perk Trenchant Strikes as its legendary Perk. Previously dropped versions of this item are unchanged. Only newly dropped versions are different.
 Corrected an error on a handful of Shields where their stat reference was assigned to the wrong tier. Some Shields were moved up to the correct tier (Tier 5 Shields that were marked at Tier 4) and some Shields were moved down to the correct tier (Tier 4 and Tier 3 Shields that were marked as Tier 5 and Tier 4 respectively).

Whirling Blade
  
  Sped up attack
  Increased damage from 145% to 160%
  Increased size of hitbox
  Added additional time to redirect attack during the start up
  Opportunity upgrade - Increased the power of the rend from 5% to 15%

Reverse Stab
    
 Slightly sped up attack animation
  Adjusted homing to account for updated attack speed
  Slightly increased hitbox size
  Added additional time to redirect attack during the start up

Defiant Stance
    
 Added additional functionality to reduce the attacker's stamina damage while active by 20%.
 Made it so the buff is applied earlier in the animation and reduced the recovery of the attack.

Defensive Formation 
  
  Increased radius of the AOE from 3m to 4m.

Shield Rush
    
 Reduced the recovery of the extra animation that is played with the upgrades by 7 frames.

Spear
Cyclone
  
 Increased damage from 130% to 165%
 Sped up attack
 Extended the hitbox down a bit to make it less likely to miss ground

Void Gauntlet

 Fixed an issue with the value not showing correctly in the Invigorating Oblivion's upgrade tooltip.
 Updated the tooltip on Cleansing Harvest to be more clear, also reduced the time the player needed to be in the harvest action for it to trigger from 1s to 0.75s.
 Void blade attacks can now have grit with the 300 CON attribute bonus.

Baleful Tether
    
 Added functionality to keep the tether active while swapping to secondar

Essence Rupture
    
 Added text to the Overflowing Essence tooltip to indicate that the effect will trigger when it ends or if the target is killed.

War Hammer

 Adjusted the timing of the Mighty Gavel ability to have the hitbox appear 1 frame sooner.
 Fixed an issue where the War Hammer Wrecking Ball ability could damage targets outside of the hit area if quickly moving the camera while attacking.
 Updated the tooltip of the Safety Measures upgrade for War Hammer's Wrecking Ball ability to state the proper functionality of Fortify.
 The named War Hammer, The Settler's Friend, has been renamed to The Diver's Companion to avoid confusion with the Hatchet.

Mighty Gavel
 
 Slightly increased the impact area of the attack.
 Reworked the Justice For All upgrade to grant one free mighty gavel use per cooldown.

Armor Breaker
  
 Increased damage from 140% to 160%.
  Increased the power of the rend from the Lasting Trauma upgrade from 20% to 30%
  Updated the Opening Act upgrade to be against targets above 70% health.

Rapier
Flurry
 
 Updated Flurry's damage to evenly distribute the damage across hits instead of having it escalate with each hit.
  Adjusted damage from being the escalating range of 47% - 83% damage for each hit, to a consistent 60% damage per stab.
  Adjusted homing to be more consistent and to properly line up with the attacks.

Tondo
   
 Proper Spacing Upgrade Updated the condition from the target being in a 4-5m range to being against targets with the rapier bleed.

Perks


 Fixed an issue that caused the Invigorated Punishment Perk to apply on basic attacks and not just abilities.

 Added additional text to clarify the functionality of the Great Axe Insatiable Gravity Well Perk.
 Fixed issue where the Empowered Amulet Perk would refresh constantly and extend the duration beyond intended durations.
  Fixed an issue where the refreshing Pillar of Fire Perk would not consistently activate on 2 targets.

Game Mode Updates
Invasion

 Increased difficulty of earlier waves to more smoothly ramp up the challenge over time.
 Invasion invites are now sent 5 minutes prior to the battle starting (previously was 15 minutes).

Total match duration shortened from 30 minutes to 25 minutes:
    
    25:00 - Wave 1 Start
    22:10 - Wave 2 Start
    19:20 - Wave 3 Start
    16:30 - Wave 4 Start
    13:20 - Wave 5 Start
    10:10 - Wave 6 Start
    07:00 - Wave 7 Start
    03:30 - Wave 8 Start
    00:00 - Complete

Outpost Rush

 Fixed a bug where melee attacks would home towards unbuilt Outpost Rush structures.
 Fixed an issue where the corrupted portal interaction was not displaying a progress circle when interacting with it.
 Fixed an issue where a bouncing projectile could sometimes clip through wooden fort platforms.
 Improved projectile explosion line of sight checks so that an explosion on the bottom of a fort walkway cannot hurt players standing on top of the walkway.

We have made the following gameplay updates to the mode:

Fort Updates
     
 Siege weapons have had their health and damage increased
 Increased base Ranged thrust damage resistance for gates
 Ranged thrust damage resistance is further increased with each upgrade

    Corrupted Portal Event update
 
 Updated event to give a brute summon after all enemies have been defeated and you close the portal by interacting with it

 Alpha wolf - Bear summons
 Ug/Dug - Specter summons
 Corrupted Portal event - Brute Summons

 Updated personal scoring to give more points for defending and capturing.

    Death Updates
 
 You will now only drop half of your resources on death

PVP Arenas

Open World PVP

Gear and Loot General

 Clothier
 Costumier
 Provender

 Changed the effect for all Bait. Baits now only effect rarity.
 Reduced the crafting cost for Bread, Cheese, Meat, and Fish Bait.

notes.title: Forged in Aeternum - Finalizing a Release
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers!

The PTR is crucial for finalizing releases, but some upcoming content remains secret. Should we surprise players in exchange for less bug tests? The answer can vary, but QA always makes the final call on if a release is ready to go live. Check out the video below to learn more about the challenges behind quality assurance and then read on for an in-depth look at the journey of a patch note.

[previewyoutube=RD8_ioPQpkM;full][/previewyoutube]

THE JOURNEY OF A PATCH NOTE
QA Manager Michael Corpora went on to walk us through the path of a bug:

“On December 6, 2022, we pushed the Winter Festival update to live servers. The Winter Convergence world event was core to this release. This was also the first world event to repeat since the New World launch. As such, we already documented and updated a test plan to account for any changes. For example, additional quests were added to engage new and returning players. When finalizing the content, we verified changes with characters that had participated in the original event along with new characters. Defects were identified and resolved, and then those fixes were verified in builds leading up to the release.“

https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/7jMUejr7RMIcAg2GTMpGRm/bd272d46d3e3c6a90bc4769cf3dc45ce/NW_WinterVillage_D_Winterconvergence22_1920x1080_Final_CT-001151.jpg

“However, following the release we received player reports that the first 3 Winter Convergence quests were not accessible for some players. After looking through all of the reports, our investigation found that quest completion data for unrelated main story quests had been reused in the update for these new quests. This particular scenario was outside of the test coverage for the Winter Convergence update.”

“Once identified, we created characters with this quest completion data to verify that they were not offered the new quests. The next step was to implement a fix and create test scenarios to verify that both the Winter Convergence quests and the main story quests functioned correctly for all characters, including those who had already participated in the live event. This fix was then merged into a patch.”

https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1iCegSW0VhghPzxTEbcdnc/7a8e62c4cbef46be3df2de9f7e4cce19/NW_Brimstone_Settelment_A_Winterconvergence22_1920x1080_Final_CT-001151__1_.jpg

“We ran all test scenarios again to verify the fix in the actual build before it went live. Once approved, the patch was released to players on December 8, 2022.“

What’s something that you can’t wait to see on the PTR? Let us know on Discord, Reddit, or the YouTube comments section. Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World Update 1.9.2
notes.notes:
https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1UMilsIMobo5isgmVxJcTv/99f900641ca986862d9816e3d0380758/NW_WispyBlossom_LifeStaff_S1Announce_Springtide_Final_CT-001427.jpg
Greetings, Adventurers!

New World Update 1.9.2 downtime will begin at 11:00PM PT (6:00AM UTC) on April 25. With the Corrupted Rabbits vanquished, the Springtide Bloom event will now blossom throughout Aeternum.

SPRINGTIDE BLOOM
The Time of Awakening has arrived. Springtide Bloom calls its children to share an ancient secret capable of granting true freedom. Help the enigmatic Bloom Herald unravel the mysteries of the ethereal Wispybloom on April 26 through May 23 and collect Springtide's fertile bounty of event-specific rewards. Harvest with caution, as swarms of vile Wispy Wasps guard the blooms with fury!

Truth Seekers must be level 25 or higher to embark upon the quest for enlightenment. Check out the full reward and lore breakdown for more details.

 “When conceiving the Springtide Bloom event, there was an opportunity to introduce some new mysteries to Aeternum,” said Narrative Designer Aaron de Orive. “The idea was to invoke a Folk Horror vibe by introducing the Children of Bloom. These individuals, dressed in creepy beekeeper robes, would tend the Wispyblooms that appear during this time of year. The blooms themselves would be harvested for their pollen, which the Children claim would allow individuals to achieve harmony and break free of the island.”
 “Now whether those were just the deranged beliefs of a strange cult or something that held some aspect of truth remains to be seen. However, voices and strange laughter can be heard when picking the blooms. And the leader of the Children, the Herald of Bloom, claims that ‘The Folk’ are watching and waiting to enter Aeternum. Exactly who or what these entities are must remain a mystery for a while longer.“

WORLD EXPERIENCE

 Adjusted tracker text to fix typos and display all objectives at once for new weapon quests that target single locations. Players can now do the objectives in any order.
 Fixed an issue that caused the player character’s hair to appear brighter than intended in shaded areas.
 Fixed an issue that blocked players from entering the cave for the quest Dearly Beloved.

AI

 Fixed a character collider issue that prevented some wolf, boar, and lion attacks from hitting the player.
